style: Match nurse-nightowl base identity exactly. True 2D PIXEL CHIBI, overhead 3/4 cozy game angle; hard-edged square pixels; warm readable limited palette with 3-4 discrete tones; strong dark selective outline, no smoothing, gradients or dithering. Head AT LEAST one third of body height. Big eyes with WHITE catchlights clearly visible at native size, never black dot eyes or closed eyes except sleep and back views. Target about 26x46 logical pixels in each 32x64 cell. Pure solid magenta #FF00FF outside figure, no magenta in character, no detached marks, text, shadows or furniture. IDENTITY: Short softly pear-shaped tired-but-cheerful adult nurse. Very large round head about 43 percent of standing body height. Warm peach/tan face, big OPEN warm-brown eyes with dark navy pupils and one clear BRIGHT WHITE square catchlight in EACH visible eye, faint tired lower-eye shading, cheerful small mouth. Broad visible forehead and hairline. Dark-blue messy high ponytail with amber tie and curved chunky tail behind the head, side-swept fringe never hides eyes, two stray tufts. Teal V-neck short-sleeve scrubs with cream pocket and small amber badge; matching teal cropped-cuff loose trousers. Charcoal neck stethoscope with pale silver chest disc. Cream socks and broad coral/ochre slippers with dark soles. No lab coat, hat, bun, glasses or scarf. The large cream-and-amber mug appears only in coffee, no mug in other actions.
